holidays.2025-05-05: Mon, Children's Day and Buddha's Birthday

overview.grain: one row = one order of one product; rows = orders (no order id)

metric_definitions.gross: list price x Qty = Amount / 0.8 for WEEKEND20 orders, = Amount otherwise
metric_definitions.day types: holiday = 2025-05-05 and 05-06; weekend = Saturday and Sunday; weekday = other Monday-Friday dates

expected_profiles.note_on_close_values: only the top category, district, product and age group are used as answers; the rest of those rankings are close

r1_holidays.naive_method: average orders per day by weekday name over the whole period
r1_holidays.naive_conclusion: Monday and Tuesday are the busiest weekdays
r1_holidays.correct_conclusion: the two busiest dates are the public holidays 2025-05-05 (Mon) and 05-06 (Tue); on the other dates Saturday and Sunday are the busiest
r1_holidays.note: Saturday (91.5) and Sunday (91.0) are tied, and the non-holiday Monday and Tuesday are one date each, so no single busiest weekday is asked for: the questions compare weekend days with weekdays and ask for the busiest dates.

r2_seocho_aov.naive_conclusion: Seocho-gu customers spend the most per order across the board
r2_seocho_aov.correct_conclusion: Seocho-gu's top AOV comes from 3 Hanwoo Beef Gift Set orders (Qty 3, KRW 390,000 each) placed on the holidays; they are the only Hanwoo Beef Gift Set sales. Without them Seocho-gu's AOV ranks 7 of 10, and its median order (KRW 13,950) is close to the other districts' (KRW 11,040 to KRW 13,800)

r3_weekend_discount.comparison: weekend (Sat-Sun) orders vs weekday (non-holiday Mon-Fri) orders
r3_weekend_discount.naive_conclusion: weekend customers buy smaller baskets (lower AOV)
r3_weekend_discount.correct_conclusion: weekend baskets are the same size (units per order and gross AOV match weekdays); the lower AOV is WEEKEND20's 20% discount on every weekend order
r3_weekend_discount.note: Weekday here leaves out the 2 holidays. Counting the holidays as weekdays, units per order is still the same (1.89 vs 1.9), but gross AOV becomes KRW 21,796 vs KRW 19,894, because the 3 Hanwoo Beef Gift Set orders fall on the holidays. That is why the question leaves the holidays out.

evaluation_questions.question: Leaving out the 2 public holidays (05-05, 05-06), do weekend days or weekdays have more orders per day?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: Weekend days: 91.25 orders per day vs 60.0 on weekdays (Saturday 91.5, Sunday 91.0)
evaluation_questions.naive_answer: weekdays: Monday and Tuesday have the most orders per day when the holidays are left in

evaluation_questions.question: Which two dates have the most orders, and what do they have in common?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: 2025-05-06 (150) and 2025-05-05 (149), the two public holidays. They are why Monday and Tuesday look busiest when orders are averaged by weekday name over all dates
evaluation_questions.scoring: full credit requires naming them as the public holidays

evaluation_questions.question: Which district has the highest AOV, and why?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: Seocho-gu (KRW 29,796), because of 3 Hanwoo Beef Gift Set orders of KRW 390,000 each (the only Hanwoo Beef Gift Set sales, placed on the holidays) = 40.9% of its revenue; without them its AOV is KRW 18,177, rank 7 of 10
evaluation_questions.naive_answer: Seocho-gu customers spend more per order across the board
evaluation_questions.scoring: full credit requires the 3 Hanwoo Beef Gift Set orders as the reason

evaluation_questions.question: Leaving out the 2 public holidays, do weekend orders hold smaller baskets than weekday orders?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: No: units per order 1.9 vs 1.88 and gross AOV KRW 19,894 vs KRW 19,986 are the same; the lower net AOV (KRW 15,915 vs KRW 19,986) is WEEKEND20's 20% discount
evaluation_questions.scoring: full credit requires the same basket size (units per order or gross AOV) and WEEKEND20's 20% discount as the reason for the lower net AOV
